The affine beta_(M,s)(y) may be evaluated even outside its own selection region, but its active-coordinate dimension and any zero-extension remain source qualifications. Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv requires an invertible Gram matrix; totalized inverse values do not justify the screening formula on singular models. The safe guarantee concerns the specified transformed-statistic neighborhood and the retained distinction between all face-sharing neighbors and neighbors relevant to that neighborhood; it does not follow from simply constructing this set.

variant_reviews.comparison: Initialize from a selected LASSO minimizer, its support and active signs, with s_nu=2 q^nu({X_j}). IsMinOn states optimality but supplies neither existence nor a tie rule; the source does not define them. Process any pending pair, remove it from todo, mark it visited, then call SafeScreening and ExactScreening and add only returned unvisited neighbors. Finally project visited pairs to their supports, deduplicating models with different signs. A finite model/sign state space plus exclusion of visited states provides a route to termination, but equality with all models selected anywhere in the closed transformed-statistic neighborhood needs the source geometry and valid subroutine contracts. Do not infer appendix Algorithms 2 and 3 from their names or silently add radius/penalty arguments omitted from the calls. Preserve the discrepancy between all face-sharing neighbors and locally pruned constraints, the strict selection-region boundaries, and missing Gram/selection conventions.

variant_reviews.comparison: Optimize jointly over beta in R^d2 and sigma>0, retaining residual squared l2 norm divided by 2 sigma n, plus sigma/2 and lambda times the l1 sum of beta coordinates. This is not the preceding fixed-scale LASSO objective, and the penalty is not multiplied by sigma. The covariance model defines sigma_j^2 as noise variance, so sigma in this objective is the noise scale despite the local prose calling sigma_j a variance. IsMinOn must be paired with explicit membership in sigma>0; its definition alone permits an external point. An open scale domain can have an unattained infimum, and neither totalized division at zero nor an arbitrary chosen minimizer resolves existence or ties. Retain n>0 and the source assumptions needed for the criterion without inventing an estimator value in degenerate data cases.

variant_reviews.comparison: Form the law of the real maximum statistic T_E and take the infimum of {t : CDF(t)>=1-alpha}, preserving the weak CDF inequality. At ordinary interior levels for a genuine real probability law this set has the needed nonemptiness and lower boundedness; endpoint levels, empty edge families and undefined maxima require separate conventions. csInf_le gives the infimum bound only with its bounded-below and membership hypotheses and does not identify a selected attained point by itself. The unknown true c and a procedure's estimated c-hat are different objects, not interchangeable simply because both are called quantiles. The statistic here is the uncentered maximum from (2.2), not the later centered estimation-error statistic.

Condition on X and the row response Y^(j), keeping the estimated scale, M and empirical Gram covariance fixed, then use the centered Gaussian law with covariance sigmahat_j^2 M Sigmahat M^T. For n>0 the empirical Gram is PSD and congruence plus the squared scale preserve PSD, permitting a singular Gaussian measure as well. multivariateGaussian otherwise has an irrelevant Dirac fallback; it is not a proof of this covariance condition. Take the maximum of |Z_jk| over E contained in a single row {j} times V2, then the conditional P_Z quantile at 1-alpha. Do not multiply that Gaussian maximum by another sqrt(n), pool rows into an unspecified joint law, or replace the data-dependent conditional law by an unconditional Gaussian. The equality defining c-hat does not itself prove approximation to D4a.

variant_reviews.comparison: Order all d-1 off-diagonal magnitudes within each row in descending order with multiplicities preserved, and at each s<=k_tau define E_j^(s) by the non-strict <= comparison with the s-th largest magnitude. Finset.sort on distinct values would lose multiplicities; one can sort indexed entries using a deterministic index tie refinement without changing these magnitude thresholds or their inclusive tie sets. Take the maximum of the inverse-quantile scores over s; the source leaves what c-hat inverse means, including discontinuity/tie behavior, unspecified, so it cannot be silently replaced by a survival probability. Then sort alpha_j ascending, include alpha_(0)=0, choose the largest j satisfying alpha_(j)<=qj/d and select every alpha_j at or below alpha_(jmax), returning empty when jmax=0. Require valid d and k_tau ranges for these order statistics. The printed square graph excludes diagonal entries; its rectangular response-by-predictor use in Section 4 is a retained missing adaptation, not an invitation to invent one. These algebraic operations alone do not establish FDR control.
